facts.business: Oval Project Engineering Limited is an engineering and construction company focused on oil and gas EPC, city gas distribution (CGD), CNG stations, operation and maintenance, civil and urban infrastructure, and a trading vertical serving the oil and gas sector.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expand the order book toward ₹1,000 crore
guidance_or_targets.by_when: Medium term (next three to five years)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Sustained double-digit revenue growth with EBITDA margin protection
Progressive movement toward positive operating cash generation
Maintenance of a conservative debt-equity position
Rising share of recurring O&M revenue

key_risks: Client concentration with a limited number of public sector owners accounting for a substantial share of the order book
Execution capacity constraints in converting order book into certified revenue at protected margins
Dependence on public capital expenditure on energy and urban infrastructure
Delays in North-East Gas Grid programme commissioning, clearance or land acquisition
Regulatory relaxation of Minimum Work Programme obligations for CGD
Monsoon and terrain conditions affecting execution
Working capital absorption from growth and trading vertical
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the Financial Statements etc., as required by the applicable accounting standards. Details mentioned in Note No. 45 & 46 of Standalone Balance Sheet as on 31 March 2026.
